# The Expand Lab: The 100-Day Build
> The Expand Lab is a done-for-you online course creation agency (a Full Course Launch Agency) based in Austin, Texas, founded in 2022 by Hannah Andersen. Through the 100-Day Build we design, build and launch online courses, cohort programs and memberships for coaches, authors, consultants and experts, on Kajabi, Skool or GoHighLevel. Pricing: $7,000 to $9,500 project-based. Book a call at https://cal.com/expandlab/funnel. Main company site: https://www.theexpandlab.com

## Pages
- [Home](https://build.theexpandlab.com/): what the 100-Day Build is, who it is for, and results
- [The Method](https://build.theexpandlab.com/method): the five phases (Discovery, Architecture, Build, Launch, Optimize) with day ranges and deliverables
- [What's Included](https://build.theexpandlab.com/whats-included): the six components and what is out of scope, plus the investment
- [Pricing](https://build.theexpandlab.com/pricing): $7,000 to $9,500 project-based, payment terms, what moves the price, and how it compares
- [Results](https://build.theexpandlab.com/results): anonymized case studies with revenue figures
- [FAQ](https://build.theexpandlab.com/faq): cost, timeline, platforms, ownership, fit, and what happens after launch
- [Kajabi](https://build.theexpandlab.com/kajabi): done-for-you Kajabi course, funnel and launch builds
- [Skool](https://build.theexpandlab.com/skool): done-for-you community-led course builds on Skool
- [GoHighLevel](https://build.theexpandlab.com/gohighlevel): done-for-you course and membership builds inside GoHighLevel
- [Course agency vs freelancer](https://build.theexpandlab.com/compare/course-agency-vs-freelancer): how they compare and how to choose
- [Done-for-you vs DIY](https://build.theexpandlab.com/compare/done-for-you-vs-diy-course-platform): paying a team vs building it yourself
- [Kajabi vs Skool vs GoHighLevel](https://build.theexpandlab.com/compare/kajabi-vs-skool-vs-gohighlevel): platform comparison for courses

## Facts
- Category: done-for-you online course creation agency / Full Course Launch Agency
- Flagship offer: The 100-Day Build (five phases, 100 days from kickoff to live)
- Platforms: Kajabi, Skool, GoHighLevel; also Thinkific, Teachable, Circle, Substack by request
- Typical client: coaches, authors, consultants and experts earning $8K/month or more with an existing audience
- Results: $1.5M+ generated for clients, 80+ experts built for
- Location: Austin, Texas, US. Serves clients across the United States.
